jobs.title: Crowdstrike Implementation Engineer/ PAM Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Crowdstrike Implementation Engineer / PAM Implementation Engineer**  
**Duration: Contract (30+day engagement)**  
**Location: Remote**

**Overview**  
An organization is seeking a Crowdstrike Implementation Engineer/ PAM Implementation Engineer to lead the deployment of CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access Management (PAM) across the enterprise. This is a short-term, hands-on engagement covering the design, configuration, integration, testing, documentation, and operational handoff of the platform.

The engineer will work across Infrastructure, Security, Identity, Compliance, and Application teams to inventory privileged accounts, implement least-privilege controls, and eliminate standing administrative access. The role owns both implementation and the transition to day-to-day operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access.
* Assess existing privileged accounts, administrative groups, service accounts, and elevated access risks.
* Design, configure, test, and deploy Just-In-Time (JIT) access policies, privilege duration controls, and role-based access controls.
* Integrate Falcon PAM with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and enterprise identity providers.
* Implement Microsoft Teams integrations, PAM browser extensions, approval chains, authorizer groups, and privilege revocation workflows.
* Automate privileged access requests, approvals, provisioning, revocation, and auditing.
* Build dashboards, reporting, monitoring, logging, and alerting, including SIEM integrations where applicable.
* Deliver architecture diagrams, administrative runbooks, and support procedures, and train administrators and support teams through knowledge transfer and operational handoff.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Hands-on experience implementing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD and Active Directory.
* Solid background in Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Experience with Just-In-Time (JIT) administration and least-privilege models.
* Windows Server administration experience.
* PowerShell scripting and API integration experience.
* Experience building workflow automation for access requests and approvals.
* Microsoft Teams administration experience.
* Experience with security monitoring, auditing, governance, and compliance.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and train technical and non-technical teams.
* Ability to work independently and deliver within a 30-day timeline.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with other PAM platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea).
* Experience integrating with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel).
* Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon platform modules beyond PAM.
* Experience in a regulated environment (e.g., healthcare/HIPAA).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted scripting and documentation tools.

Pay: $70.00 - $90.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

* Privileged Access Management (PAM): 10 years (Required)
* CrowdStrike Privileged Access: 5 years (Required)
* CrowdStrike Falcon : 3 years (Required)
* Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Billing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Dental insurance

**About Triton Medical Solutions**

Triton Medical Solutions is a medical billing and revenue cycle management company based in Tempe, Arizona. Since 2011, we have supported practices nationwide, including dental, orofacial pain, TMJ, dental sleep medicine, and CBCT radiology providers billing medical insurance.

**About the position**

We are seeking an experienced Implementation Billing Specialist to lead the day-to-day medical billing work for new clients as they onboard with Triton Medical Solutions. This is a hands-on role that combines full-cycle medical insurance billing with client implementation, workflow development, training, and coordination across internal teams.

You will manage claims from submission through payment and resolution, proactively address denials and outstanding accounts receivable, identify billing issues, and help establish accurate, efficient workflows tailored to each client. You will also track implementation tasks and deadlines, guide clients through billing procedures and software, and work closely with our Implementation Manager and other departments to keep onboarding on schedule.

As clients transition into ongoing billing operations, you will ensure workflows are documented, outstanding claims and follow-up needs are clearly communicated, and responsibilities are handed off smoothly. Following appropriate training, you will also provide designated backup for routine client questions, training, and implementation follow-up.

Our recommended platform for most new clients is AdvancedMD, although some clients retain their existing EHR or practice management software. The ideal candidate is an experienced medical biller who takes ownership, works independently, stays organized across multiple clients, communicates clearly, and follows issues through to resolution.

**What you will do**

* **Manage full-cycle medical billing:** Handle charge entry, claim submission, clearinghouse rejections, denial resolution, appeals, payer follow-up, payment posting, secondary billing, and accounts receivable management for clients during implementation.
* **Monitor claims and resolve billing issues:** Review claim accuracy and billing readiness, investigate underpayments and unpaid claims, monitor aging reports and filing deadlines, reconcile ERA/EOB payments, and identify recurring issues that affect reimbursement.
* **Coordinate client implementation:** Track implementation tasks, deadlines, outstanding issues, dependencies, and next steps across multiple clients. Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and communicate potential delays or barriers promptly.
* **Develop billing workflows and procedures:** Establish and document client-specific billing processes, checklists, and procedures to support accurate, consistent billing and a smooth transition to ongoing operations.
* **Train and support clients:** Guide clients through billing procedures, software workflows, claim requirements, and supporting documentation. Identify training needs and provide follow-up guidance.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work closely with the Implementation Manager, clients, billing operations, IT, and credentialing or contracting staff to resolve issues and keep implementation activities moving forward.
* **Provide designated backup coverage:** Following appropriate training, assist with routine client updates, implementation questions, scheduled training, and follow-up coordination.
* **Prepare complete billing handoffs:** Communicate open claims, accounts receivable status, denial and appeal deadlines, payer concerns, documented workflows, and unresolved tasks to the ongoing billing team.
* **Maintain accurate documentation and confidentiality:** Keep implementation trackers and client records current, follow through on commitments, and handle confidential information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

**What we are looking for**

* **At least five years of hands-on medical insurance billing experience**, with a strong understanding of the full billing cycle from claim submission through payment posting and accounts receivable resolution.
* **Strong claims and accounts receivable expertise**, including rejections, denials, appeals, payer follow-up, ERA/EOB reconciliation, secondary billing, underpayments, aging reports, and timely filing requirements.
* **Knowledge of medical insurance billing requirements**, particularly commercial insurance and Medicare. The ability to research payer requirements and learn applicable Medicaid, managed care, and Medicare DME billing requirements is important.
* **Excellent organization and follow-through**, with the ability to independently manage multiple client accounts, prioritize competing deadlines, maintain accurate task trackers, and resolve issues without repeated reminders.
* **Problem-solving and analytical skills**, including the ability to investigate billing issues, identify root causes, recognize denial trends, recommend corrective actions, and escalate complex issues with a proposed next step.
* **Experience documenting and improving workflows**, developing procedures, identifying implementation gaps, and training clients or staff on billing processes and software.
* **Strong communication and client service skills**, with the ability to explain billing requirements clearly, coordinate with multiple teams, document decisions, and keep clients and coworkers informed.
* **Proficiency with billing systems and tools**, including EHR or practice management systems, clearinghouses, payer portals, spreadsheets, and task-tracking software, along with the ability to learn new platforms.

This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Digital Health Innovation (DHI) is hiring a remote Onboarding Specialist to guide organizations in the set up and adoption of their software platforms. The work involves owning the adoption process: understanding the customer’s use-case, preparing the platform for their contract, and the facilitation of training, onboarding, and support activities.

* **Position Title:** Onboarding Specialist
* **Status:** Independent contractor, long-term
* **Location:** Remote (home-based), United States
* **Hours:** Somewhat flexible. Monday through Friday (about 20-25 hours per week)
* **Compensation:** Based on experience, paid every two weeks. Long term contractors earn time off with pay.

**About Us:** Digital Health Innovation (DHI) and Behavioral Health Innovation (BHI) together form a boutique healthcare software company based in the Charlotte, North Carolina area, building secure, cloud-based platforms that help universities, K-12 school districts, and behavioral health organizations support the people they serve. Founded on more than 30 years of behavioral health and technology leadership, we combine rigorous security and software standards with the responsiveness and personal attention of a dedicated focused team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* The goal is to set up, guide and support customers in the use of the software, leaving customers happy, confident and self-sufficient. Responsibilities include:
* Lead onboarding for each new university customer from contract signature to go-live: kickoff call, timeline, checklist, and go-live confirmation.
* Configure the platform to each customer's preferences (user roles, settings, forms, and workflows) and record every choice made.
* Coordinate with customer staff and campus IT contacts on approvals, access, and security or privacy questions and other needs.
* Train customer staff live and with clear written guides so they can run the system and train their own colleagues.
* Anticipate and prevent problems: identify blockers such as approvals, term start dates, and access early, and raise them before they delay go-live.
* Create, document, and maintain onboarding workflows, checklists, and templates where none exist. Follow them consistently and improve them after each customer.
* Keep accurate records of each customer's status, decisions, and open items.
* Escalate product issues and feature requests to the development team with clear, reproducible details.
* Serve as a liaison between customer and DHI-BHI staff and support the customer as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications Required**

* 3 to 5 years in a similar implementation, onboarding, or customer-facing role, owning processes end-to-end.
* Tech-savvy: learns web-based software quickly, is comfortable configuring settings, and can troubleshoot basic problems.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable at follow-through.
* Self-leadership. Takes initiative in the work without needing prompting, post training.
* A record of creating workflows, checklists, or documentation where none existed, following and improving them.
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical steps to non-technical staff.
* Sound judgment and composure with busy or frustrated staff, and a serious approach to commitments.
* Own computer with adequate performance, and stable internet suitable for video conferencing.
* Availability to work in the timeframe required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with higher education, healthcare, or behavioral health technology.
* Prior software implementation, onboarding, or customer training experience.

**Holidays**

* **Major Holidays Off:** New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.
* **Flexible Holiday Schedule:** Observed holidays may be shifted to other days by agreement, with at least 7 days' advance notice.

**Engagement Terms**

This is a home-based, long-term independent contractor position.

* **Work Environment:** You provide your own computer and stable internet suitable for daily video conferencing.
* **Time and Payment:** Hours are tracked with time-tracking software, and that record is the basis for payment. Payment is made every two weeks by electronic payment.
* **How to Apply**: Please apply at the following link: **https://forms.gle/YQ5LqcPmWqZfZ7qj6**
* (Original post https://digitalhealthinnovation.com/job/onboarding-specialist/)

**Note**  
\* Contact with company staff outside of the application process will not be accepted.

* **Adaptive Telehealth** is a brand name under **Digital Health Innovation** and **Behavioral Health Innovation**. DHI and BHI consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Experience:

* in a similar implementation, onboarding: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

**Job Type:** Contract (W2 only, no 1099, no Corp-to-Corp)

**Pay:** $68.44 per hour

**Location:** Remote; preference for candidates living in North Carolina

**About the Opportunity**

Changing Technologies, Inc. (CTI) is hiring an HMS Analyst for the North Carolina Health Information Exchange Authority (NC HIEA), part of the NC Department of Information Technology (NCDIT). You will support the HIE Medicaid Services (HMS) program, a partnership between NC HIEA and NC Medicaid (NCDHHS Division of Health Benefits) that improves Medicaid quality and population health through better data exchange: moving to digital quality measures (dQMs), improving health-related social needs (HRSN) data exchange, and improving care management data sharing. You will work with guidance on simple to medium complexity efforts.

**What You Will Do**

* Support the rollout, expansion, and daily operations of Medicaid data exchange services within NC HIEA
* Improve HRSN data capture and onboard early adopters
* Turn program and partner needs into clear technical and workflow requirements
* Support Continuity of Care Document (CCD) and Admission-Discharge-Transfer (ADT) data integration
* Coordinate work across teams to improve data quality and interoperability
* Troubleshoot issues with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Guide testing and onboarding so new data connections are accurate, secure, and aligned with statewide population health priorities
* Use SQL, relational databases, and BI dashboards for healthcare reporting and analysis
* Explain technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical partners

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in healthcare IT and EHR operations, supporting healthcare systems, analytics, technical support, and EHR workflows
* 3+ years with advanced SQL, relational databases, BI dashboards, and healthcare reporting
* 3+ years in business analysis: requirements documentation, process analysis, troubleshooting, and solution design
* 3+ years with healthcare data standards and compliance, including ICD-10, CPT, LOINC, and HIPAA
* 3+ years in stakeholder communication: translating technical concepts, managing priorities, and working with teams and vendors
* Strong familiarity with health information exchange standards

**Work Location and Schedule**

* Remote; preference for candidates living in North Carolina
* Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
* Start date: October 26, 2026; contract through October 25, 2027
* Interview: webcam only

**Work Authorization**

* Improve how Medicaid data moves across North Carolina's health information exchange

Submit your resume through Indeed. This requirement has an immediate submission deadline, so apply today. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly.
